signature.name: VTask.elim
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : α → Type u_2} -> (γ : Type u_3) -> (fγ : (a : α) × (β a → γ) → γ) -> WType β → γ

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total and structurally recursive on a well-founded inductive type; there are no junk-value or edge conventions.

facts.statement: ¬ ∀ (γ : Type) (fγ : (a : Unit) × (Empty → γ) → γ) (t1 t2 : WType (fun _ : Unit => Empty)), VTask.elim γ fγ t1 = VTask.elim γ fγ t2 → t1 = t2
